text_block_list.text:
Thanks to her art going viral online, 
Marche Lorraine had been invited to 
present a new work at an exhibition——

text_block_list.name: Marche Lorraine
text_block_list.text:
(Ngh… What do I do? Oh no… Am I getting 
art block…?)

text_block_list.name: Marche Lorraine
text_block_list.text:
(…Usually ideas for pieces just come up 
naturally, but now…)

text_block_list.name: Marche Lorraine
text_block_list.text:
(…Nothing's coming to me… Even though I 
WANT to make something, I can't think of 
what…)

text_block_list.name: Marche Lorraine
text_block_list.text:
(…W-What do I do? Maybe it'll just go away 
by itself?)

text_block_list.name: Marche Lorraine
text_block_list.text: (B-But what if it doesn't? …Oh, no…)

text_block_list.name: Marche Lorraine
text_block_list.text:
(…Maybe I should talk to Love-chan… No. I 
can't.)

text_block_list.name: Marche Lorraine
text_block_list.text:
(She trusted me to handle this… I can't 
betray her trust…)

text_block_list.name: Marche Lorraine
text_block_list.text:
(Oh… Maybe… Maybe if I read the comments, 
it'll help cure my art block!)

"You're really going to be at an 
exhibition?" "you do stuff IRL!?" "CAN'T 
WAIT!!"

text_block_list.name: Marche Lorraine
text_block_list.text:
(…Ngh… They've got high hopes for me too… 
It's so much attention…)

text_block_list.name: Marche Lorraine
text_block_list.text:
I- I need to think of something… Something 
that'll make everyone happy…!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: …Maru-chan…
choice_data_list: Are you not going to talk to her?
Are you not going to talk to her?

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
No, not yet. I mean, look how hard she's 
trying.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
If I said something now, I'd just make her 
feel worse.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
So I'm going to get her creative juices 
flowing a different way… My way!

text_block_list.name: Marche Lorraine
text_block_list.text: ……Ah.

text_block_list.name: Marche Lorraine
text_block_list.text:
"Yo! G'morning! How are you doing? Because 
Maru-chan's doing great!"

…So says the puppet, but her face told a 
different story.

I figured that, as long as it was a third 
party like me asking, and not Loves Only 
You, then it wouldn't affect her too 
badly.

text_block_list.name: Marche Lorraine
text_block_list.text: …… "To be honest, not yet!"

text_block_list.name: Marche Lorraine
text_block_list.text:
"Expectations are so high that I'm 
overthinking it, and it's actually making 
it harder to come up with something… You 
know how it is!"

text_block_list.name: Marche Lorraine
text_block_list.text:
"I'm really worried about letting them 
down, and I guess it's giving me art 
block. Ha ha. Ha."

It sounded to me like she wasn't telling 
the whole truth. Like she was trying to 
hide her anxiety.
choice_data_list: Don't worry about quality, just create.
How'd you feel making the last piece?
Maybe try a change of scenery?

text_block_list.name: Marche Lorraine
text_block_list.text:
……… "But I have to worry about quality! 
It's for an exhibition, remember?"

I told her, exhibition or not, getting her 
hands moving to work on something would be 
more productive than doing nothing but 
worry.

text_block_list.name: Marche Lorraine
text_block_list.text: "…Oh. Yeah, you might be right!"

text_block_list.name: Marche Lorraine
text_block_list.text:
"Anything's better than an empty canvas! I 
like the way you think!"

text_block_list.name: Marche Lorraine
text_block_list.text: "Thanks! I'm going to get right to it～!"

Marche Lorraine bowed her head a bit 
behind her puppet. I hoped things would go 
well for her.

text_block_list.name: Marche Lorraine
text_block_list.text: (…… …That piece was…)

text_block_list.name: Marche Lorraine
text_block_list.text:
…… "I had fun painting it, duh! I can 
hardly forget how fun it was."

text_block_list.name: Marche Lorraine
text_block_list.text:
"Hmm… Maybe taking another look at it will 
blow my art block away. I'm going to give 
it a shot!"

text_block_list.name: Marche Lorraine
text_block_list.text: "Thanks for the talk! See ya☆"

Marche Lorraine bowed her head a bit 
behind her puppet. I hoped things would go 
well for her.

text_block_list.name: Marche Lorraine
text_block_list.text:
"Change of scenery? Oh… Yeah! That might 
be a good idea."

text_block_list.name: Marche Lorraine
text_block_list.text:
"A change of scenery might help with my 
art block… It's worth a shot ☆"

text_block_list.name: Marche Lorraine
text_block_list.text:
"Thanks for the advice! I'm going to try 
it right away. See ya!"

Marche Lorraine bowed her head a bit 
behind her puppet. I hoped things would go 
well for her.
